short_description:
Where to sell jewelry in GTA 6: Yasmani, the fence in Little Cuba (Vice City), pays the most for jewelry, from Chapter 3. Before that, Dunk in Port Gellhorn (Chapter 2) buys it for less, and Tyrone in La Perle pays a medium rate. Pawn shops don't take stolen jewelry. Once Yasmani is open you can also drop goods at your garage and pick the fence (it takes longer). Rates come from fan guides: check the fence's rate on your map. No story spoilers.

📍 Map Spot #12 of our GTA 6 map series: every spot is in the playlist "GTA 6 Map: Where to Find It".

Sources: Game8, Beebom, Sportskeeda, Libertycity, Game Rant, GAMES.GG.

Every spot is pinned on our interactive map at vicereplay.com (Guides).
